tool.description: Re-save delimited data with a different field separator, fixing quoting for the new delimiter (fields containing it get quoted; fields that no longer need quotes are unquoted). `from`/`to` are a single char or one of 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Defaults: from ',', to 'tab'.

from.description: Current field separator: a single char, or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.

to.description: Target field separator: a single char, or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default 'tab'.
